description:
Record a dated figure backing a zone (or one of its levers), linked to
the query that computed it, on a connection you may read. Recording the
same label again on the same zone or lever replaces the figure.

kind.description: key (headline), fact, extrapolation (derived) or change (moved since the last run)
kind.title: Kind

label.description: What the figure is ("Taux de rupture top 500")
label.title: Label

lever.description: Attach the figure to this lever of the zone instead, as <LEVER:id> or its uuid
lever.title: Lever

query.description: The query that computed it: the query_id myriade_query returns (or its 8-hex short id)
query.title: Query

value.description: The figure as it should read ("7,8 %", "≈ 1,2 M€")
value.title: Value

zone.description: The zone's slug, from its document's ```zone block
zone.title: Zone

name: myriade_audit_record_evidence
